chunks: Ali ibn Ahmad narrated to us, saying: Ubaydullah ibn Musa al-Alawi narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Qutayba al-A'sha, from Abban ibn Taghlub, who said: I heard Abu Abdillah Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon him) saying:

When the banner of the truth appears, the people of the East and the people of the West will curse it. Do you know why that is? I said: No. He said: Because of what the people endure from his family before his appearance.

key_terms.رَايَةُ الْحَقِّ: Banner of the truth (referring to the Mahdi's standard)

ai.seo_question: Why will people curse the Mahdi when his banner appears?
ai.summary: In this narration from Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq, the 'curse' from the East and West signifies the widespread distress and tribulations (al-ghabat) that the Mahdi's lineage endures prior to his emergence, serving as a divine preparation for his appearance. This highlights the concept of 'hidden suffering' within the Ahl al-Bayt, where their trials act as a catalyst for the global recognition of the banner of truth. The event underscores the continuity of leadership struggles from the Prophet's household to the final Imam.

en.abdullah-al-shahin: (4) Ali bin Ahmad narrated from Obaydillah bin Musa al-Alawi from Muhammad bin al-Husayn from Muhammad bin Sinan from Qutayba al-A’sha that Abban bin Taghlub had said: “Abu Abdullah as-Sadiq (as) said: “

When the banner of the truth (al-Mahdi) appears, the people of the east and the west will curse it. Do you know why?” I said: “No, I do not.” He said: “That is because of what harms the people receive from his (al-Mahdi’s) family before his appearance.”
